threshold_provenance_policy.numeric_threshold_rule: Every numeric science or admission criterion must carry one allowed source category and an explicit rationale.
threshold_provenance_policy.literature_boundary: Literature-comparison values identify published observables or sampling epochs only unless a primary source explicitly supplies a numerical tolerance. No AthenaK-selected release threshold may be described as literature derived.

paired_seed_rule.rule: Every selected seed must retain a complete coarse-AMR-fine triad.
paired_seed_rule.rationale: Complete paired triads preserve within-seed grid comparisons and prevent resource pressure from selectively dropping a variant.

ordered_prefix_rule.rule: The frozen seed set must be an ordered prefix of the preregistered pool.
ordered_prefix_rule.rationale: The ordered prefix prevents post-pilot or post-output selection of apparently favorable random realizations.

resource_only_freeze_rule.rule: After excluded exact-deck scaling and I/O pilots pass, and before any qualifying launch or output inspection, freeze N as the largest affordable complete paired-triad prefix.
resource_only_freeze_rule.rationale: The freeze uses resource evidence only, preserving the largest affordable preregistered paired design without science-output-driven sample-size selection.

post_qualifying_execution_rule.rule: After the first qualifying launch begins, expansion, contraction, seed dropping, and science-output-driven sample-size changes are forbidden; retries retain the frozen seed and complete triad.
post_qualifying_execution_rule.rationale: An immutable frozen matrix prevents optional stopping and selective removal while preserving paired comparisons after runtime failures.

core_fit_failure_rule.rule: If the mandatory core plus contingency does not fit the measured ledger, fail closed and launch no qualifying production attempt.
core_fit_failure_rule.rationale: The mandatory core cannot be weakened to fit the budget, and the global ledger cap cannot be exceeded.

numeric_rules.rationale: Three paired seeds are the minimum preregistered repeatability core; this is an analysis-design choice, not a literature sample size.
Nine attempts are the complete three-variant realization of the mandatory three-seed paired core, not a literature-derived count.
Eight paired triads cap the preregistered reserve pool without promising an unaffordable full matrix; this is a project resource choice with no literature origin.
Twenty-four is only the maximum preregistered design envelope, not a promised run count or a literature-derived sample size.
The global ten-thousand node-hour cap is an AthenaK project resource-control limit and has no scientific literature origin.
The fifteen-percent proportional reserve is an AthenaK engineering recovery allowance selected before qualifying execution and has no scientific literature origin.
At least one measured complete-triad cost is reserved so a runtime retry does not require seed dropping; this is an engineering allowance with no literature origin.

required_timing.rule: after excluded exact-deck scaling and I/O pilots pass and before any qualifying launch, qualifying output inspection, or qualifying production reservation
required_timing.rationale: This ordering isolates campaign-size selection from qualifying science outputs and prevents unbudgeted production reservations.

required_resource_evidence.rule: bind the measured global ledger snapshot, the complete reservation manifest for every other registered campaign, and the exact-deck pilot completion receipt
required_resource_evidence.rationale: The freeze must account for measured use and all prior obligations before assigning the remaining ledger to Q011.

selection_rule.rule: select the largest integer N in the preregistered range whose complete paired-triad production cost and stated contingency fit the global ledger after all other obligations
selection_rule.rationale: Largest-affordable selection uses only pre-launch resource evidence and never observed scientific outcomes.

budget_equation.rule: global consumed + global currently reserved after all other campaign reservations + unreserved Q011 nonbaseline obligations + N times measured conservative complete-triad cost + max(one complete-triad cost, contingency fraction times N times measured complete-triad cost) <= global ledger cap
budget_equation.rationale: The equation reserves all measured and registered obligations plus a retry and proportional recovery allowance before production.

prohibited_inputs.rule: qualifying measurements, gate results, physical observables, and science-output-derived costs or preferences
prohibited_inputs.rationale: Excluding qualifying science information prevents optional stopping and outcome-dependent campaign-size selection.

post_freeze_rule.rule: After the first qualifying launch begins, expansion, contraction, seed dropping, and science-output-driven sample-size changes are forbidden; retries retain the frozen seed and complete triad.
post_freeze_rule.rationale: An immutable frozen matrix prevents optional stopping and selective removal while preserving paired comparisons after runtime failures.

all_frozen_N.rule: report every paired seed value, every preregistered paired contrast, and the observed min-max range without seed dropping
all_frozen_N.rationale: Transparent paired reporting exposes realization variability and prevents a summary statistic from hiding an unfavorable seed.

N_equals_3.rule: report paired values, paired contrasts, and ranges; make only narrow claims about the three preregistered realizations and do not make broad population inference
N_equals_3.rationale: Three paired realizations do not support a useful distribution-free population interval, so the honest scope is descriptive and narrow.

N_greater_than_3.rule: before launch freeze the exact two-sided distribution-free order-statistic interval for the median paired contrast, report its achieved finite-sample coverage, document ties, and avoid asymptotic-normal or standard-error claims
N_greater_than_3.rationale: An exact order-statistic interval remains auditable for the small frozen seed ensemble and does not assume Gaussian paired contrasts.

inference_scope.rule: the interval describes repeatability over the preregistered seed ensemble and does not establish universal astrophysical-parameter population inference
inference_scope.rationale: Seed replication quantifies numerical-realization sensitivity but does not sample the broader physical parameter population.

numeric_rules.rationale: At three paired seeds the exact median interval at the chosen coverage is unavailable, so only paired values and ranges support narrow claims; this is not a literature threshold.
Four is the smallest frozen N admitting the preregistered exact two-sided median interval at the chosen coverage; this is a finite-sample analysis property, not a literature sample size.

Eighty-percent nominal coverage guarantees an exact interval for every allowed N above three and permits an inner order-statistic interval at N seven and eight; achieved exact coverage is always reported and no literature origin is implied.

shock_front.orientation_rationale: The reflecting wall and denser downstream state are at lower x1, so density falls across the outward-moving shock as x1 increases.

search_window_relative_to_ideal_surface_.rationale: The fixed symmetric window is an AthenaK-selected applicability bound wide enough to admit shock corrugation while excluding distant structures; it is not a literature-derived tolerance.

maximum_absolute_offset_from_ideal_surfa.rationale: The maximum offset is an AthenaK-selected fail-closed applicability screen chosen before output inspection; no cited source supplies this tolerance.

gate_policy.literature_boundary: Sun and Bai Section 5.4 supplies comparison observables but not universal numerical acceptance tolerances

resource_pilot_policy.compute_scaling: derive full-geometry short-step output-suppressed decks only from the exact nine-output successor deck
resource_pilot_policy.io_scaling: derive reduced-transverse full-time decks retaining the exact nine-output successor cadence

maximum_consumed_node_hours.rationale: The cap is the preregistered Q011 engineering-pilot budget inside the project-wide 10000 node-hour ceiling and has no scientific literature origin.
